title: The explicit dual-to-Hom components commute with extension of the field of definition
statement:
theorem component_extension (B : Duality D l hl Ω X)
    (K : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X)
    (L : Index l Ω) (h : K.stage ≤ L) :
    B.duality.dual.map ((stageSystem l Ω X).isoToStage K h).hom.op ≫
        (component l Ω X D hl B K).hom =
      (component l Ω X D hl B ((inclusion L).obj (K.toStage h))).hom ≫
        (homDual l Ω X B.omega (fun M ↦ allPairs l Ω X D hl B.finite M B.omega)).map
          ((stageSystem l Ω X).isoToStage K h).hom.op

proof.text: Use the duality and omega scalar equations from DualityProperties to replace transport of the two recorded inclusion comparisons by the finite beta and omega maps. betaNormalized and ExtensionProperties identify the former with the normalized rational comparison.

The finite HomIdentification evaluation and integral_evaluation equations, with rationalHom_identifications and the specified Hom scalar evaluation square, identify both transported finite comparisons as the transpose of the same scalar-extended evaluation. Injectivity of the finite tensor-Hom adjunction gives equality. The specified identity and tower equations cancel the self-transition unitors in stageHomInclusion. Apply inclusion L and the canonical inclusion-transition isomorphisms to obtain naturality along isoToStage.
